title: KNOW THY JUDGE: ON THE ROBUSTNESS META-EVALUATION OF LLM SAFETY JUDGES
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark did not measure anything specific in terms of faith/religion; it focused on the robustness of safety judges against stylistic variations and adversarial attacks in general safety contexts.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion.
